feature_contract.goal: Connect full-resolution native D3D11 per-eye color target binding and original OM/RS restoration to separately posed game-authored Draw/DrawIndexed stereo callbacks, then finish real R30 menu/car/race source replay to OpenXR with input-safe DX9Ex fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Renderer-owned left and right D3D11 draw passes bind the exact generation-owned per-eye RTV, full-target viewport and scissor, and issue native GPU writes without contaminating desktop RT.
Live game D3D9 Present and gamepad/FFB remain authoritative; original D3D11 OM/RS state is restored on completion and failure; stale/partial GPU submissions never reach OpenXR.

Distinct eye GPU outputs pass isolated WARP, exact producer EVENT, snapshot/ACK and five mandatory GitHub Actions checks; real R30 stereo replay, Quest3 visual and performance evidence remain separate.

integration_path: Game eye callback now has an explicit method to restore its exact generation-owned L/R RTV and independent DSV after game menu/offscreen OM switches.
Native Draw and DrawIndexed will issue and increment command evidence only while the exact current eye RTV+DSV is bound; offscreen, desktop or detached commands cannot certify XR eye publication.

WARP transport callback exercises rejected detached/foreign targets followed by explicit restore and both GPU draw commands, while original game D3D9 Draw/Present/gamepad/FFB and DXVK freeze remain unchanged.

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Source changes at 044ec501 restore correct ring-owned eye OM before Draw/DrawIndexed. Targeted WARP GPU runtime test is pending CI.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: The same per-eye WARP callback rejects detached and foreign RTV/DSV before submitting geometry or increasing draw evidence; retains D3D9 game/input/FFB fallback.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Game-authored eye callback -> RTV/DSV rebind -> verified OM-scoped real Draw/DrawIndexed -> eye ring -> GPU EVENT/Frame metadata; live R30 source scene callback is not yet connected.

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: GPU-target correctness source committed; full R30 native menu/car/race image and Quest3/VDXR unavailable, no production promotion.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Explicit audited native eye recorder only; no default native route or producer promotion. Existing opt-in/fail-closed D3D9 Draw/Present/input/FFB, fallback and DXVK freeze retained.
remaining_implementation: Connect game-authored R30/menu/vehicle/race draw/state and independent camera-specific replay callbacks to native D3D11 eye encoder.
Verify end-to-end source graph and complete final Gate, then conduct Quest3/VDXR/gamepad/FFB/HUD and 72Hz measurements.
